Abort on host load > available CPUs; one unchanged environment retry only.
r4.acceptance: Exact baseline tokens on cold/warm, decoded UTF-8 output, serialize/sha256, cache/output isolation, concurrent read-only and non-word/token-boundary cases; measured allocation lower in target workloads without unexplained material CPU regression or control loss. Kotlin-host only, no Android/Gradle claim.

no changed checkpoint or model weights
